title: Chinese Sausage and Mash Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful stir fry made with sausages, vegetables, and mashed potatoes, inspired by Chinese cuisine.

ingredients.name: Northern Irish sausages
ingredients.notes: Choose a brand that is gluten-free

ingredients.name: Roasted vegetables (such as carrots, bell peppers, and broccoli)
ingredients.notes: Roasted in the oven with olive oil and salt

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Used as a marinade and stir-fry sauce

instructions: 2. Toss the roasted vegetables with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
3. Cook the Northern Irish sausages in a pan over medium heat, breaking them up with a spoon as they cook.
4. Add the soy sauce to the pan and stir to combine.
5. Add the roasted vegetables to the pan and stir to combine.
6. Serve the sausages and vegetables over golden mashed potatoes.
7. Garnish with chopped green onions and serve hot.
